newsitem.title: USA: Hertel elected new speaker of Michigan House.
newsitem.headline: Hertel elected new speaker of Michigan House.

text.p: State Rep. Curtis Hertel, D-Detroit, was elected speaker of the Michigan House Thursday, just a day after Democrats learned they had become the majority party in that chamber.
Andi Brancato, Hertel's spokeswoman, said Tuesday's election will give Democrats a 58 to 52 edge in the House come January.
Hertel has served as House minority leader since Republicans broke a tie over control of the House in the 1994 election.
Among the issues Hertel plans to tackle in his role as Speaker next year are restoring cuts in adult education and examining tax credits for daycare, college tuition and elderly care, Brancato said.
The Democrat-controlled House will still face a Republican-controlled Senate and Republican Gov. John Engler next year.
